_about: All BTPC revision jobs for the GCP VM <vm-1> (t2d-standard-32), merged 21 Nov 2026 from jobs_main.json, jobs_proton.json and jobs_piserver.json.
Run from ~/r007/repo with: MAX_MEMORY_MB=12000 ~/r007/env/bin/python dft/revision/jobqueue.py run --jobs dft/revision/jobs_vm.json --root ~/r007/queue --slots 8 --threads 4
est_hours are msi wall hours at 4 threads (the VM per job is expected to be faster); longest chains are listed first.

jobs.item: C0 (host preparation for run_case.sh)
jobs.command: if [ ! -x tools/env/bin/python ]; then mkdir -p tools && ln -sfn "$(dirname "$(dirname {python})")" tools/env; fi; if [ ! -x tools/multiwfn/Multiwfn_noGUI ] && [ -x "$HOME/r007/multiwfn/Multiwfn_noGUI" ]; then ln -sfn "$HOME/r007/multiwfn" tools/multiwfn; fi; tools/env/bin/python -c 'import pyscf, geometric; print("pyscf", pyscf.__version__, "geometric", geometric.__version__)'; ls -l tools/

jobs.item: C0 (P2_1/n ion pair, gas: pre-optimisation, optimisation, proton check, finite-difference frequencies, FMO/cubes/molden)
jobs.cost: gas: 6-31G(d) pre-optimisation 15-60 steps x 1.8 min (cap 3 h) + 5-40 evaluations x 7.3 min (cap 100 / 12 h) + FD Hessian 198 gradients x 7.3 min (measured 21 Nov) in 33 chunks + fmo ~1 h
jobs.note: resumable: an interruption loses at most one 3-column chunk (6 gradients, ~0.7 h) or one optimisation step; FD worker peak RSS 6.4 GB at MAX_MEMORY_MB 5500 (msi has 7.1 GB)

jobs.item: C0 (P2_1/n ion pair, IEF-PCM water: pre-optimisation, optimisation, proton check, FMO/cubes/molden; frequencies in c0_btpcz_pcm_softmode)
jobs.cost: IEF-PCM: 6-31G(d) pre-optimisation 15-60 steps x 5.2 min (cap 6 h) + 30-100 evaluations x 17.3 min (cap 100 / 30 h) + fmo ~1.2 h
jobs.note: resumable (rerun continues); stops early on a stall (gradient criteria met for 10 evaluations with < 1e-6 Ha spread); at a cap it is accepted only on the btpc_pcm rule, otherwise it fails and waits for the user (raise --opt-max-hours to continue)

jobs.note: item 4 wants all five criteria, so no stall stop here: at the 30 h cap the job fails (resumable) and the user decides (continue with a larger --max-hours, or accept on forces with --negligible-stop 10)
